HN 当天没有赚钱相关的（新闻性质）。换回 Reddit——等限流解除，同时抓 Indie Hackers。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html,application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "(async function(){",
 " // Indie Hackers 有 RSS？试试他们的热门帖",
 " const cands=[",
 " ['ih_home','https://www.indiehackers.com/'],",
 " ['ih_rss','https://www.indiehackers.com/rss'],",
 " ['ih_feed','https://www.indiehackers.com/feed.xml']",
 " ];",
 " for(const c of cands){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(c[1]);",
 " console.log('=== '+c[0]+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length);",
 " const m=/<title>([\\s\\S]{0,200}?)<\\/title>/i.exec(r.body);",
 " console.log(' title:', m?m[1].replace(/\\s+/g,' ').substring(0,120):'(none)');",
 " const items=(r.body.match(/<item>/g)||[]).length;",
 " const entries=(r.body.match(/<entry>/g)||[]).length;",
 " console.log(' items/entries:', items, entries);",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(c[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,5000)});",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ih.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ih.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe Indie Hackers feeds", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 4000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };

  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html,application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",

  "    ['ih_home','https://www.indiehackers.com/'],",

  "  ];",

  "      const r=await get(c[1]);",

  "      console.log('    title:', m?m[1].replace(/\\s+/g,' ').substring(0,120):'(none)');",
  "      const items=(r.body.match(/<item>/g)||[]).length;",
  "      const entries=(r.body.match(/<entry>/g)||[]).length;",
  "      console.log('    items/entries:', items, entries);",
  "    }catch(e){ console.log(c[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,5000)});",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ih.cjs", content: js });
